I'm Jon, an independent web designer based in Bordeaux[[bordeaux]] — originally from Jersey[[jersey]], and I've spent over ten years in France now. I've been designing and building for the web for more than 25 years, working across strategy, design and development, which is a fairly rare mix for one person.

Outside work I'm a keen street photographer, a Leica-toting one, and I nearly always have music on while I work or shoot. I've also travelled a fair bit — a long stint around South East Asia and India years ago, and more recently places with a bit of a reputation.
